customManagers.description: Every version Renovate cannot find by itself carries a `# renovate:` line directly above it: Talos and Kubernetes in talos/talenv.yaml, the bootstrap charts, their image digests, Flux and Headscale in infra/, chart image digests in kubernetes/, OpenTofu, age and etcd in the workflows, hcloud-upload-image in scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh. A value written as tag@sha256:digest has both parts updated. One manager reads them all, so a version without the line is the only way to freeze silently.

packageRules.description: A Talos or Kubernetes bump changes the machine configs OpenTofu applies, but the nodes only move with a rolling upgrade. Approve it on the dashboard when the upgrade is planned.

The Flux operator, its image, the Flux instance chart and the manifests artifact are released together and must move together. Flux itself moves with them: the operator only installs a Flux version that the pinned manifests artifact contains.
prBodyNotes: `flux_version` in `infra/bootstrap-manifests.tf` must be a directory under `flux/` in the pinned `flux-operator-manifests` artifact, or the FluxInstance stops reconciling. A Flux release newer than the artifact waits for the next operator release.

packageRules.description: The cloud controller's image is pinned by digest beside its chart, so the two move in one PR.
The CSI driver and its sidecars are pinned by digest beside the chart, so they move in one PR.
prBodyNotes: Keep each sidecar on the tag the new chart's `values.yaml` ships unless its release notes say the chart's RBAC and flags still fit.

packageRules.description: A Cilium minor or major release changes the network every pod depends on. Approve it on the dashboard and apply it in a maintenance window.
Headscale is installed once by cloud-init, which ignores later changes; a bump records the version and its checksum must be updated with it. Upgrade the server by hand from the release notes.
prBodyNotes: Update `headscale_sha256` in `infra/headscale.tf` from the release's `checksums.txt`, then upgrade the running server by hand.

packageRules.description: age is installed from a pinned checksum, which Renovate cannot update. Approve on the dashboard and update the checksum in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update `AGE_SHA256` in `.forgejo/workflows/etcd-backup-check.yml` to the sha256 of the new `linux-amd64` archive.

packageRules.description: The restore check uses the etcd release the cluster runs, which Talos chooses. Move it when a Talos upgrade moves etcd, not before.
hcloud-upload-image is installed from pinned checksums, which Renovate cannot update. Approve on the dashboard and update the checksums in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update the three `upload_tool_sha256_*` values in `scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh` from the release's `hcloud-upload-image_<version>_checksums.txt`.

packageRules.description: required_version constrains OpenTofu, which Renovate would otherwise look up as Terraform. OpenTofu's version is tracked through TOFU_VERSION in the workflow.
